fit_note: Per-step online probing of UI elements during VLM inference, summarised into prompt hints; not a persistent library.
Offline and semi-online step-level evaluation toolkit plus a large Chinese mobile trajectory dataset.
GUI agent judge plays generated games to adjudicate rubrics; also a playtester feeding code refinement, outside CUA tasks.
Mid-trains the VLM on LLM-distilled textual planning and causal transition knowledge before post-training.
New tasks synthesised from weakness reports of tasks the teacher solves but the student fails; plus masked DPO.
Binary step-level PRM rewards on sampled candidate actions at on-policy states drive step-level GRPO.
Agent trained to emit an explicit memory field retaining transient screen information, via virtual-environment SFT and RL.
Tree synthesis localises policy-induced error states and synthesises long-horizon recovery trajectories for SFT.
Autonomous app exploration builds a reusable UI-state knowledge graph that guides a small runtime agent.
Predicted-box area gates up to two crop-and-reground stages around the click; trained with difficulty-weighted GRPO.
